provenance.how: constructed from the ADR's literals at the pinned ref and cross-checked against the core's own builders (tests/unit/mobile/test_push_wire_contract.py); not captured from a running relay, because no relay route emits the machine-side shapes yet

example.error: a device cannot restore itself — use the computer or your account

notes: Means exactly one thing: the request did not present this machine's operator key. It is NOT a locality test and must not be described as one — the relay authenticates /api/ with one cookie check, so a phone and the CLI look identical to it.
This is the sentence the APP renders. The CLI, which runs on the machine already, reports the fact its reader can act on instead: a mismatched key is named as one.

The key is minted on the machine and never given to a device, and the tunnel gateway rebuilds request headers from a fixed allowlist, so the header cannot survive the Radient hop (QA row Q31 is the regression guard on that allowlist).
